description: Renders a document diff with a summary header, an optional side-by-side old/new plain-text comparison, and an inline colored view of added, removed, and unchanged segments computed from two documents or a precomputed compare result.

parameters.name: ComparisonResult
parameters.description: Whether side-by-side text panes should be shown.

parameters.name: NewTitle
parameters.description: Optional title for the old side.

parameters.name: SideBySide
parameters.description: Optional title for the new side.
